name: MeiG Smart Technology Co., Ltd
summary: MeiG Smart Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of wireless communication modules and Internet of Things solutions in China and internationally. Its products include 5G smart, 5G and 4G LTE, AI computing, automotive, smart, LPWA, and GNSS modules; and wireless data solutions for use in smart positioning and tracking, payment methods for retailers, blind spot monitoring driving, logistics, and alarm and gas alarm solutions in energy sectors. MeiG Smart Technology Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Shenzhen MeiG Smart Technology Co., Ltd and changed its name to MeiG Smart Technology Co., Ltd. in December 2017.
